rawContent: Tomorrow at 10am, @BFLO_CC is meeting to vote on a budget that includes $143 million for Buffalo police - 30% of the entire budget - with $4.3 for all social services, including youth and senior services and workforce development #DefundBPD #DefundthePolice #BlackLivesMatter

I’m calling on my council member @DariusPridgen to reduce funding for Buffalo Police - especially any money for weapons or military equipment - and to increase funding for services that will reduce the need for policing in Buffalo. #DefundBPD #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
